cases.title: With the new switch ON, a ROTATE Copy and then a SCALE Copy of pit P3 landing on P3 leave every one of P3's pipes joined to P3, and CE says so once per copy
cases.expected: With linking.pitCopyKeepsOriginalPipeEnds true when AutoCAD starts: a plain COPY of P3 by 0,-5000 makes P8 (R34's control). Then ROTATE Copy of P3 by 90 degrees about 53777.7,-25569.9 makes P11 on top of P3, and the command line says '[CE] P11 sits on pipe ends already joined to P3; they stay joined to P3.' once. Then SCALE Copy by 1.5 about the same point makes P12, and the command line says 'P12 sits on pipe ends already joined to P3; they stay joined to P3.' once. No 'Pit schedule cell for P3' line prints. The CE log has none of the five stolen pipe-end lines of the 3.0.86 run (10A901 from=WT9 to=P11, 10A98D from=P4 to=P11, 110136 from=WT4 to=P11, 109E23 from=P12 to=P2, 110179 from=WT3 to=P12). The copies' labels read P11 and P12 and P3's own label still reads P3. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The pipe-end owner is chosen by the live copy relink when AutoCAD ends the native ROTATE or SCALE command; the unit tests rebuild the owner walk but cannot read the real pit records (pre-review E item 3.3.3), and the switch is read from the real settings file at start.
not_automated: DERIVED: P11 and P12 are the first free numbers on DRV1_B1 after the COPY takes P8 (as R34 and R34s); the five pipe ids and their From pits come from the 3.0.86 log, not from a fresh read of this copy.

P3 keeping all five pipes is proven by the ABSENCE of the five stolen-end lines plus the keep-back line, not by reading P3's pipe list (the robot read of a pipe shows only handle, object and layer: R19 run B5). The Inspector on each of P3's pipes is a Codex or Tim look.
U twice is driven and recorded, NOT judged: a red here must be a BUG-1227 red, not a U question. Pre-review E check 5 (U twice puts the drawing back) is therefore recorded only.
Not driven: an EXACT snap to P3 (true tie), copy-then-erase-the-original (pre-review E item 3.2.3), drawings already damaged on 3.0.84 to 3.0.86 (the fix does not repair them).
